qualified_scope: macOS arm64 fixed-source signed CLI and three packaged helpers; nine affected private-stdio native contracts and one component-cache contract with synthetic loopback fixtures.
limits: Source review, tests, artifact qualification, merge and installed acceptance are separate.

Only macOS arm64 private stdio and named native consumers/helpers are qualified. Linux, Windows, remote production execution, live accounts/providers, physical audio and installation/release remain unmeasured.
No latency, throughput, memory, billing or cost benchmark.
Historical dependency findings retain their recorded sources and dates; no new security audit or ignored advisory.
Earlier certified ranges and missing historical 153-test manifest remain unchanged.
HumanCommand is user-deferred and unadvertised. Shared MCP, remote production execution and optional product experiments are outside this qualification.

historical_scope.certified_ranges: Preserved in native state; this qualification covers only the fixed current target and retained source/behavior limits.
historical_scope.conditional_remote_credential_snapshot: Earlier qualification could not qualify conditional remote credential snapshots because fixture DNS failed or returned a reserved address. Native address protection stays enabled. Current consumers use private stdio; reopen only with a concrete retained remote consumer. Original source assertions and historical delivery evidence remain in Git.
historical_scope.older_certified_ranges: Retained in native checkpoint and Git history. This migration does not change their coverage limits.
historical_scope.unrecovered_historical_claims: The older exact 153-test manifest remains unknown. No historical claim was filled from a rebuilt artifact.

signing_recovery.cause: The configured default signing identity was unavailable.
signing_recovery.resolution: Use the existing valid certificate matching the previous qualified artifact and the same repository-owned component signing commands.

source_integrity.limit: The exact official archive was built anew; the package and generated schema were measured, not inferred from version or ancestry.

prepared_development_package.scope: Explicit preparation only; app packaging and startup do not compile Codex. Select an existing valid code-signing identity when rebuilding; no certificate fingerprint is retained here.

development_preparation.schema_expectation: Use the schema generated by the actual signed CLI; the source-only provisional fingerprint was replaced before final import.

retained_source_inclusion.limit: Source inclusion only; affected behavior is qualified by the current exact-artifact regressions. Previous execution receipts apply only to their original artifact.

source_validation.limit: Relevant diffs, affected implementations and test bodies were read. No upstream test suite was run.

retained_consumers.limit: This registry retains reconstruction selectors. Nine named native contracts executed against the current artifact. All other test results remain bound to their historical artifact and source; they were not rerun or counted as current passes.

component_cache_repair.contract: Import, corrupt and repair CLI, schema and all three helpers offline; reject a wrong source commit and preserve the prior cache.

before.limit: The first incomplete-response scenario failed; later scenarios were not reached on the old artifact.

unreported_context_regression.boundary: Use native context accounting and auto compaction. No local token estimate or compaction controller was added.

dependency_identity_delta.limit: Resolved identity comparison, not a vulnerability audit.

unreported_usage.initial_failure: The unencoded fixture contained fewer than 5000 estimated tokens. Both artifacts correctly stayed below the threshold. These attempts do not demonstrate a runtime regression.
unreported_usage.repair: Match the upstream fixture base64 envelope and 12000-byte reasoning payload; keep the same 5000 limit and expected compaction sequence.

provider_mode.initial: The arbitrary Fixture provider selected native local compaction, while the assertion expected the retained OpenAI remote compaction contract.
provider_mode.repair: Use the same OpenAI provider identity as the existing native compaction fixture. Keep the loopback endpoint and unchanged assertions.

initial_failures: Required isolated component cache not prepared
cold_settings.repair: Use canonical system-temporary HOME and the existing explicit prepare-codex command with separate preparation CODEX_HOME.

working_directory.cause: The old fixture reused temporary HOME as the execution directory, outside the OS-account home authorized by SelectedWorkingDirectory.
working_directory.repair: Reuse recap_socket::fixture_working_directory for native history and ordinary runtime requests; keep account/cache files temporary. Production permission checks and existing assertions remain intact.

installed_application.limit: Build and isolated protocol fixtures do not establish installed-app acceptance.

documentation_lifecycle.state_source: OpenWiki-managed metadata; only pages affected by this migration are selected.

delivery_status: Qualified code commit. The native checkpoint and public PR record exact-head checks and merge readback.
consumer_limits: No live accounts/providers, physical audio, remote production, other platforms, performance or installed desktop acceptance. Shared MCP and HumanCommand remain outside this qualification.
